text:
maya: FYI customer reported their trial promo landed in a CI-created sandbox, not their main org. they need the credits moved.

maya: Customer: Acme Apps. They say after SSO provisioning a shadow workspace was created and the promo applied there. Main org id: org_acme_42. Shadow workspace id: wks_ci_shadow_0007. Promo code: TRIAL-ACME-MAR.

sam_billing: can you paste the promo code and both workspace ids (full) + ticket link? i'll need to validate the promo balance and check any billing constraints.

maya: Promo: TRIAL-ACME-MAR
org: org_acme_42
main workspace: wks_acme_main_0001
shadow workspace: wks_ci_shadow_0007
Ticket: https://support.redwood.com/tickets/RT-49821
Audit excerpt (sensitive) ->
```
actor=service_account:svc-ci-0007 event=apply_promo target=wks_ci_shadow_0007 promo=TRIAL-ACME-MAR ts=2026-02-11T15:03:12Z
```

devon: looks like the promo was consumed by the CI service account during an SSO provisioning flow that created a duplicate workspace mapping. audit confirms agent=svc-ci-0007 applied the promo. likely race between SSO mapping and account linking.

lina: we can reassign the credit bucket with the internal admin API. example payload: 
```
POST /internal/admin/credits/transfer
{
  "from_workspace_id": "wks_ci_shadow_0007",
  "to_workspace_id": "wks_acme_main_0001",
  "amount": "10000",  // in cents of credit units
  "reason": "customer requested reassign after SSO duplicate workspace"
}
```
note: transfer requires `force=true` and an audit_note header. it will create an audit event and preserve original promo metadata.

sam_billing: OK please attach the legal-approved audit note and include the ticket id in the request. also confirm the amount to transfer (full balance vs partial). i need to sign off before actual move.

maya: customer confirms they want the full remaining trial balance moved. devon, can you run a dry-run and post results here?

devon: running dry-run now: `./tools/transfer_credits --from wks_ci_shadow_0007 --to wks_acme_main_0001 --amount 10000 --dry-run`

devon: dry-run output:
```
DRY RUN: eligible_amount=10000
from_balance_before=10000
to_balance_before=0
no-policy-conflicts=true
```

promo-bot: Promo TRIAL-ACME-MAR status: applied -> wks_ci_shadow_0007, remaining_units=10000, created_by=svc-ci-0007

sam_billing: approved to move full 10000 units to wks_acme_main_0001. please include audit_note: "RT-49821: manual transfer after SSO duplicate workspace created by svc-ci-0007" and cc billing@redwood.com

devon: i will schedule the transfer in ~2 hours (need quiet window for admin API). will paste final request & response here once done.

maya: thanks team — i'll notify Acme Apps and include the ETA. :thumbsup:

sam_billing: please ensure we don't change promo metadata so we keep the original grant attribution.

devon: noted — transfer preserves promo_origin fields. executing after billing ack.

maya: closing loop: customer updated and waiting on confirmation. i'll update ticket when transfer completes.
